description: Luminate Year-End 2025 — global headline: 5.1 tn ondemand audio streams (+9.6 %), ex-US 3.7 tn (+11.6 %), US 1.4 tn (+4.6 %), 253 mi tracks on streaming, 120.5 mi (~47 %) under 10 streams. The catalog-supply/consumer-platform lens — fourth in the corpus's music-money frame.
source: Luminate Year-End 2025 Music Industry Report. Figures verified via MBW (22 Jan 2026).
licence: Luminate published figures; MBW press coverage.
notes: The Luminate Year-End PDF is downloadable from luminatedata.com/reports/yearend-music-industry-report-2025; headline figures are publicly cited. May 2026 'State of the Industry' conference deck is a SEPARATE Luminate release, PDF-gated behind a lead form — not in this ingest.
